examples.name: Quote band
examples.summary: `variant="quote"` sets the quote alone as a full-width band, with no logos: the design sample's QuoteBand. `quote-variant="highlight"` gives it the featured register with the mark beside the text.

examples.name: Registry
examples.summary: The wall built straight from the client registry: each entry's light/dark pair, or its single file with the `artwork` that says which theme inverts it, is drawn right on both themes by `Logo`; the quote's company mark comes from the registry too, and an outlined `secondary-action` sits beside the primary one.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { CLIENTS } from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/client-registry'
  import LogoWallQuote from '@aziontech/webkit/logo-wall-quote'

  const WALL = [
    'Agibank',
    'iFood',
    'Itaú',
    'GPA',
    'Netshoes',
    'Renner',
    'Magalu',
    'Dafiti',
    'Prime Video'
  ]

  const logos = WALL.map((name) => CLIENTS.find((client) => client.name === name))

  const zoop = CLIENTS.find((client) => client.name === 'Zoop')
</script>

<template>
  <LogoWallQuote
    eyebrow="Customers"
    title="Trusted by the largest retailers and banks"
    aria-label="Retailers and banks running on Azion"
    :logos="logos"
    :quote="{
      text: 'Azion delivered the advanced protection and superior performance we needed, with fast implementation and immediate results.',
      name: 'Ismael Aguilar',
      jobTitle: 'Information Security Manager at Zoop',
      logo: zoop.logo,
      logoLight: zoop.logoLight,
      artwork: zoop.artwork,
      logoAlt: zoop.name
    }"
    :primary-action="{
      label: 'Read the case study',
      href: 'https://example.com/stories',
      trailing: true
    }"
    :secondary-action="{ label: 'See all customers', href: 'https://example.com/customers' }"
  />
</template>
